books.title: Beautiful World, Where Are You
books.author: Sally Rooney
books.synopsis: Two old friends, novelist Alice and literary editor Eileen, trade long emails about desire, faith, art and a world in crisis while their own love lives with Felix and Simon stumble toward uncertain footing.
